description: Bounded local PostgreSQL concurrency ramp for the authenticated Preview read boundary. The ramp records latency and throughput at increasing concurrency, but it cannot claim production capacity, an approved operating threshold or a saturation boundary unless an explicit failure/degradation transition is observed and independently reviewed.

classificationRules.candidateSafeConcurrency: highest executed concurrency with all 2xx, no transport error and no 5xx in this ephemeral run only
classificationRules.firstSaturationSignal: first step with transport error, 5xx, non-2xx or reviewed material latency/throughput degradation

abortCriteria: any cross-tenant or authorization invariant failure
any persisted token or synthetic identifier in the result
any attempt to run with production credentials or production traffic
limitations: single authenticated Preview read route only
ephemeral GitHub-hosted runner and local PostgreSQL 16
fixed request counts rather than sustained arrival rate
no MinIO operation in the measured path
no deliberate overload beyond the bounded concurrency steps
no production network, TLS, autoscaling, connection pool or noisy-neighbor behavior
